_meta.purpose: Per-source license register. Query commercial_safe before exposing any source in the production query path.
_meta.reminder: Re-verify before commercial launch. Terms change. This is not legal advice.

clinicaltrials_gov.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
clinicaltrials_gov.notes: ~50 req/min/IP. Use requests library (httpx blocked by Cloudflare bot detection).

openfda.name: openFDA
openfda.notes: 240 req/min with free API key. Bulk JSON downloads at open.fda.gov/apis/downloads.

fda_orange_book.name: FDA Orange Book
fda_orange_book.notes: Monthly ZIP download. Approved drugs + patent/exclusivity.

drugs_at_fda.name: Drugs@FDA
drugs_at_fda.notes: Tab-delimited ZIP, 12 tables, updated each weekday morning.

nih_reporter.name: NIH RePORTER
nih_reporter.notes: 500 records/page, 10k result cap — partition queries. Also bulk ExPORTER files.

pubmed.name: PubMed / MEDLINE E-utilities
pubmed.notes: 3 req/sec without key, 10 with free key. Abstracts may carry third-party copyright — respect per-article terms.

openalex.name: OpenAlex
openalex.notes: ~474M works. Best free commercial-safe bibliometric backbone. Hourly polling for updates.

who_gho.name: WHO Global Health Observatory OData API
who_gho.license: Open — WHO Terms of Use (more permissive than ICTRP)
who_gho.notes: 2300+ indicators, no auth, JSON/XML. Commercial-safe burden proxy replacing GBD. Cite WHO.

cdc_wonder.name: CDC WONDER
cdc_wonder.notes: Mortality/natality/cancer. XML-based API requires form POST. US burden proxy.

cdc_places.name: CDC PLACES
cdc_places.notes: Model-based local chronic disease prevalence. Socrata API.

cms_spending.name: CMS Medicare Part D / Part B Drug Spending
cms_spending.notes: Gross drug cost, beneficiaries, per-claim. Excludes rebates.

rxnorm_rxnav.name: RxNorm / RxNav API
rxnorm_rxnav.notes: 20 req/sec. Drug join key. Normalizes brand/generic/ingredient.

mondo.name: MONDO Disease Ontology
mondo.notes: Primary disease join key. Maps OMIM/Orphanet/ICD/MeSH/SNOMED. Cite Monarch Initiative.

chembl.name: ChEMBL
chembl.notes: Share-alike on derivatives. ~2.4M compounds, bioactivity, mechanisms.

open_targets.name: Open Targets Platform
open_targets.notes: Component licenses vary (ChEMBL CC BY-SA, FAERS CC0, EFO Apache-2.0). Disease IDs use EFO/MONDO.

gdelt.name: GDELT 2.0 DOC API
gdelt.notes: 15-min updates, 3-month rolling window, no full text (links only).

ihme_gbd.name: IHME Global Burden of Disease
ihme_gbd.notes: NON-COMMERCIAL ONLY. R&D/prototyping only. License for commercial use or replace with WHO GHO + CDC WONDER.

who_ictrp.name: WHO ICTRP
who_ictrp.notes: PROHIBITED: 'shall not use information extracted from the ICTRP database for marketing, promotional or commercial purposes.' Use ClinicalTrials.gov + EU CTIS instead.

drugbank_full.name: DrugBank Full Database
drugbank_full.notes: NC = non-commercial only. Only the CC0 Open Data subset (~3%) is commercial-safe. License DrugBank+ for commercial use.

drugbank_open.name: DrugBank Open Data (CC0 subset)
drugbank_open.notes: Only ~3% of DrugBank content: vocabulary + structures. Safe commercially.

newsapi_free.name: NewsAPI.org free tier
newsapi_free.license: No commercial use on free tier
newsapi_free.notes: Free tier explicitly bars commercial use. Use GDELT + RSS feeds instead.
